Scoping review that did not pool data; single-study figures (87.94% GAGS, 71.8%, 100%, 65.2%, 13.7 vs 4.6 weeks) were cut because the review reports other studies' numbers and the primary sources could not be identified from the retrieved text; the 13% vs 31% figure now cites its primary source [9].

claims.text: Scoping review included 21 studies, 4 of them randomized controlled trials
claims.quote: A total of 21 studies were ultimately included in the review ... which include 1 case-control study, 1 cohort study, 9 cross-sectional studies, ... 4 randomized controlled trials

claims.text: Studies were described in narrative form because they were too different to pool
claims.quote: we determined that quantitative evidence synthesis was not feasible due to differences between design and measures of the studies included in our review. As such, our results are presented in narrative form for each outcome.

claims.text: Teledermatology well-suited to acne; similar outcomes to in-person care on several acne-grading scales
claims.quote: It was found that teledermatology is well-suited to the effective management of acne vulgaris. When compared to in-person care, teledermatology resulted in similar outcomes on several acne-grading scales.

claims.text: Follow-up/compliance lower with virtual care
claims.quote: However, compliance was found to be lower for virtual care.

claims.text: Patient satisfaction comparable, large proportion preferring virtual care
claims.quote: Additionally, patient satisfaction was comparable, with a large proportion of patients preferring virtual care to traditional in-person visits.

claims.text: Isotretinoin: virtual visits may ease pregnancy tests and iPLEDGE steps before each prescription
claims.quote: The preference for teledermatology for patients on isotretinoin may be related to the number of additional tasks to be completed prior to receiving a prescription, specifically for females, including pregnancy tests, and in the United States, satisfying iPLEDGE requirements.

claims.text: Waits significantly longer in rural areas; teledermatology may improve rural access (farther travel)
claims.quote: Not only is teledermatology of particular value in rural areas, where there is a 30-fold increase in travel distance required to see a dermatologist, but wait times have been demonstrated to be significantly longer

claims.text: Delays matter most for acne patients at risk of permanent scarring who need prompt treatment
claims.quote: This is particularly important for patients adversely impacted by delays, such as those with irreversible scarring who need prompt treatment.

claims.text: Review suggests an in-person first visit as one option, then virtual follow-up
claims.quote: One solution for this, however, may be for dermatologists to include their first visit as an in-person appointment to accurately assess the lesion and decide on the best form of treatment, and move to virtual appointments for follow-up
